narrationScript: Now it's time to put your knowledge of INSERT and UPDATE into practice with a hands-on activity. We'll be managing an Inventory table, which currently holds information about various items, their quantities, and when they were last updated. Your task for this first part is to perform two operations. First, you'll INSERT a new item into the table: a 'Doodad D' with an ItemID of 4, a Quantity of 100, and LastUpdated to today's date. Remember to explicitly list your columns for good practice. Second, you'll UPDATE an existing item. 'Widget A', with ItemID 1, had a new shipment. You need to increase its Quantity by 50 and also update its LastUpdated date to today. Pay close attention to your WHERE clause to ensure you only update 'Widget A'. Take your time, refer back to the syntax we just covered, and make sure your queries are precise. You'll find starter code provided to guide you.
